item.title: Latest Climate Report Warns of Major Upheaval to California Way of Life
item.description: The dire projections come from the state’s Climate Change Assessment, which analyzes the impacts of changing weather patterns on the nation’s most-populous state.
item.dc:creator: Soumya Karlamangla
item.media:description: The report finds that without major intervention, as much as three-quarters of California’s beaches could disappear — either seasonally or permanently — by 2100 because of coastal erosion.

item.title: That Huge Republican Cash Edge? It’s in Senate Races, Not House Races.
item.description: With Republicans seen as less likely to hold their majority in the House, the party is focusing more on the battle for the Senate, where it is vastly outspending Democrats on ads.
item.dc:creator: Shane Goldmacher

item.title: Vital Early Voting Period Begins in Texas
item.description: Early voting in Texas, where the outcome of the Senate race could determine which party controls the chamber, will run through Oct. 30.
item.dc:creator: J. David Goodman
item.media:credit: Meridith Kohut for The New York Times
item.media:description: A polling site in Cypress, Texas, during the state’s primary election runoff in May.

item.title: Midterm Elections: Who Is Winning the Race for Congress?
item.description: It’s Oct. 19 — 15 days from the midterms. Here’s the state of play.
item.dc:creator: Jess Bidgood

item.title: Republicans in Ohio Are Worried About Turnout. Here’s What They’re Doing About It.
item.description: To boost Senator Jon Husted, who is in a tight race to keep his seat, some Republicans who were making a jobs pitch have pivoted to focus on socialism.
item.dc:creator: Emily Davies
item.media:credit: Dustin Franz for The New York Times
item.media:description: Tanya Karabanovs, a volunteer at the Cuyahoga County G.O.P. headquarters, surrounded by unclaimed yard signs. She said that volunteer turnout had been down this midterm cycle.

item.title: Ken Paxton Has Tried to Overturn Tight Elections. He’s in One of His Own.
item.description: The Texas attorney general’s powers could come under scrutiny in a close Senate contest, though election experts say courts would likely constrain him.
item.dc:creator: J. David Goodman and Alexandra Berzon
item.media:description: Ken Paxton, Republican nominee for the U.S. Senate, at a rally where President Donald Trump spoke in Denton, Texas, earlier this month.

item.title: At a Last-Hope Health Clinic, Desperation, Kindness and Fear for What’s Next
item.description: These doctors and community health workers are a safety net for patients losing coverage as premiums soar and Medicaid cuts mount, even as their clinic struggles to stay afloat.
item.dc:creator: Jan Hoffman and Erin Schaff

item.title: The Frenzy Behind Getting an Initiative on the California Ballot
item.description: An army of signature gatherers made plenty of cash hitting the streets to qualify various November initiatives.
item.dc:creator: Laurel Rosenhall
item.media:credit: Mike Kai Chen for The New York Times
item.media:description: Dederek Huff collected signatures using the same skills he said he had developed in a very different setting: selling party drugs on the Las Vegas Strip.

item.title: Trump Campaigns for Republicans as Turmoil Mounts in Washington
item.description: Our White House correspondent Tyler Pager traveled with President Trump as he campaigned across the country ahead of the midterms. As the president touted his record, political drama mounted in Washington.
item.dc:creator: Tyler Pager, Nour Idriss and Pierre Kattar

item.title: Larry David Mocks the D.S.A. Some Are Not Amused.
item.description: The comedian satirized the Democratic Socialists of America, its platform and its opposition to Israel in an essay that some did not LOL at.
item.dc:creator: Lisa Lerer and Evan Gorelick
item.media:description: The comedian Larry David spoofed the Democratic Socialists of America in a satire in which he imagined joining the organization and shaping its manifesto with new proposals.

item.title: Talarico Kicks Off Campaign Tour of Texas as Senate Election Looms
item.description: The Democratic candidate invoked a rallying cry from the TV show “Friday Night Lights” as he began his final campaign push before the Nov. 3 election.
item.dc:creator: Jesus Jiménez
item.media:description: James Talarico speaking in Plano, Texas, the first stop on his campaign tour, on Sunday.

item.title: Trump Defends Plans to Ease Russia Sanctions and Hints at a Hostage Deal
item.description: The president on Sunday justified his reversal of almost five years of sanctions against Russia as part of peace negotiations. He did not name any hostage.
item.dc:creator: David E. Sanger
item.media:description: President Trump wrote on social media on Sunday: “I am in the process of negotiating Peace in the war between Russia and Ukraine, and don’t want to do anything that will drive, foolishly, Russia away from the bargaining table.”

item.title: June 17, 1994: Millions Watched Police Chase O.J. Simpson in a Bronco
item.description: The chase occurred days after his ex-wife and her friend were killed. New details shed light on the role that a mobster might have played in helping Mr. Simpson.
item.dc:creator: Christina Morales
item.media:description: On June 17, 1994, the police engaged in a televised, slow-speed pursuit of a white Bronco carrying O.J. Simpson, who was being charged with two murders.

item.title: Coast Guard Halts Search for Survivors of Capsized Boat Off Mexico
item.description: Some 11 people were missing but 16 were rescued, including three who had injuries consistent with shark bites, the authorities said.
item.dc:creator: Bernard Mokam
item.media:description: Coast Guard helicopters were used in the effort to rescue people whose boat capsized off the Pacific Coast on Friday.

item.title: Key Players in the O.J. Simpson Trial
item.description: More than 30 years later, the people involved in what became known as the “trial of the century” are still household names.
item.dc:creator: Bernard Mokam
item.media:description: O.J. Simpson in court during the early stages of his 1994 murder trial.

item.title: 2028 Presidential ‘Shadow Primary’ Descends on the Midterm Elections
item.description: The schedule is especially packed in New Hampshire, an early presidential nominating state where there is a competitive Senate race Democrats are flocking to this month.
item.dc:creator: Evan Gorelick
item.media:description: Gov. Gavin Newsom of California taking the stage during a campaign event for Representative Chris Pappas, the Democratic Senate nominee, in Exeter, N.H., on Saturday.

item.title: Migrants From Ukraine and Sudan to Keep Deportation Protections for Now
item.description: Temporary Protected Status for the two countries was set to expire on Monday. The Trump administration said an announcement would be made “at the appropriate time.”
item.dc:creator: Madeleine Ngo
item.media:credit: Valerie Plesch for The New York Times
item.media:description: The decision to hold off on an announcement about Ukrainian and Sudanese migrants mirrored a similar move by the Trump administration last month to allow people from El Salvador to keep their deportation protections for now.

item.title: Trump Hits Campaign Trail as White House Turmoil Weighs on GOP Midterm Prospects
item.description: As Trump held rallies around the nation, his White House was consumed by dramas that reinforce how his presidency has become a drag on his party’s prospects in the midterms.
item.dc:creator: Tyler Pager
item.media:description: President Trump arriving in West Palm Beach, Fla., after giving remarks at a midterm election campaign rally in Highland Heights, Ky., on Saturday.

item.title: Driver Is Released After Plowing Onto Soccer Field in Wichita, Kan., Killing Two
item.description: The police in Wichita, Kan., said the driver was released pending the results of toxicology testing. A 6-year-old child and a 35-year-old man were killed.
item.dc:creator: Maia Spoto and Lauren Hard
item.media:description: The police were conducting a mechanical examination of the pickup involved in the deaths at soccer fields in Wichita, Kan.

item.title: Semi-Truck Rollover Spills Dozens of Cattle Across Downtown Kansas City
item.description: Some of the animals died, while others escaped and were roaming around downtown. The search and roundup of the livestock continued into the early afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Adeel Hassan
item.media:description: The crash early Sunday in Kansas City, Mo., forced the closure of some interstate lanes into the early afternoon, officials said.

item.title: Obama Defends Rep. Ilhan Omar Amid Trump Administration Inquiry
item.description: Federal agents searched Ms. Omar’s Washington home last week and issued subpoenas to some family members in search of evidence of fraud in immigration paperwork.
item.dc:creator: Adam Sella
item.media:credit: Ben Brewer for The New York Times
item.media:description: Representative Ilhan Omar has condemned the search of her home, calling it an effort by the Trump administration “to target political enemies and weaponize federal law enforcement.”

item.title: Trump Outlines Rapid Plan to Close and Overhaul D.C. Golf Course
item.description: The plan to begin work transforming the course in four weeks injected fresh urgency into a federal lawsuit opposing changes to East Potomac Golf Links.
item.dc:creator: Zach Montague
item.media:credit: Andrew Leyden for The New York Times
item.media:description: The Trump administration removed hundreds of trees from East Potomac Golf Links earlier this month, drawing a rebuke from a federal judge.

item.title: Trump Endorses Netanyahu as Best U.S. Partner in Tight Israeli Election
item.description: The president praised the embattled prime minister for his endurance, saying any other candidate would be the “wrong Leader.”
item.dc:creator: Tyler Pager and Aaron Boxerman
item.media:credit: Tierney L. Cross/The New York Times
item.media:description: “Bibi Netanyahu has been Strong, Brave, and Brilliant in the face of tremendous opposition,” President Trump wrote of the Israeli prime minister on Sunday.
